quotes.text: 1. ¿Quién realiza la mayor parte de las tareas de la casa?
quotes.location: VII. ORGANIZACIÓN DEL HOGAR, p. 6, Q1

quotes.text: 2. ¿Qué otras personas ayudan en las tareas de la casa?
quotes.location: VII. ORGANIZACIÓN DEL HOGAR, p. 6, Q2

quotes.text: ... no podía trabajar por razones personales? (cuidado del hogar, estudios, incapacidad)

assessments.reasoning:
For responsibility: Section VII of Cuestionario de Hogar asks who performs most of the household tasks ('¿Quién realiza la mayor parte de las tareas de la casa?') and who helps ('¿Qué otras personas ayudan en las tareas de la casa?'). The survey does not explicitly ask who is in charge of, plans, organises, or is responsible for domestic or care work. As specified, questions asking who carries out tasks do not satisfy the responsibility criterion. Therefore, responsibility is false.

For performance: Section VII of Cuestionario de Hogar explicitly asks who carries out the main domestic chores ('¿Quién realiza la mayor parte de las tareas de la casa?') and who helps with them ('¿Qué otras personas ayudan en las tareas de la casa?'). Therefore, performance is true.

For magnitude: The instrument nowhere asks for or records the amount of time (hours, minutes) or frequency of unpaid domestic or care work done by household members. Therefore, magnitude is false.
